content: Shipment 4821 arrived on 14 September at the Mumbai warehouse. It was received by Rahul Sharma.
Shipment 4821 arrived on 16 September at the Mumbai facility, according to security logs.
Rahul Sharma works for ABC Logistics and was present at the Mumbai warehouse on 14 September.
CCTV footage confirms Rahul Sharma entered the Mumbai warehouse at 10:15 AM on 14 September and left at 11:40 AM.
Invoice 9012 for Shipment 9012 was issued by ABC Logistics to XYZ Traders on 18 September. Total amount recorded as accurate and undisputed.
Shipment 9012 was delivered to XYZ Traders on 20 September by driver Priya Menon. No discrepancies were reported.
Priya Menon stated that the Mumbai warehouse manager on duty during the Shipment 4821 incident was Arjun Verma, not Rahul Sharma.
